card.name: Right before a form of 'chosen'
card.fires_on: Small words (was, were, 've, has, is, will, the) right where the next word is likely 'chosen', 'choose' or 'selected', mostly when someone picks a site, item, date or option.

modes.label: Choosing a body site
modes.description: Instructions about selecting or rotating an injection or patch site, where the next word is a choice verb.
